brief:
Takeaways
What I believe about this

We build first for the regulars who come every morning and lose out when the sourdough is gone by nine; reserving their loaf has to take zero effort.

Guidance to the team

Design the first version around a morning regular securing their sourdough before it sells out, end to end from browse to collect. No logins and no forms: they should never have to fill anything in.

Keep

brief:
Takeaways
What I believe about this

For a regular, ordering ahead should feel like the baker already knows you: your usual loaf is set aside the moment you say your first name.

Guidance to the team

Design 'Book your usual' so a regular reserves their loaf with just their first name: no account, no payment, no form fields. Anything that makes them fill something in is out.

Keep
